name: Accuser
source:
A night out takes a drastic turn as Iris' best friend is accused of a crime. She takes it upon herself to find the truth before her friend gets sent straight into a cell.

[from [url=https://ambrozie.itch.io/accuser]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
艾丽丝最好的朋友被指控犯罪，夜晚的外出发生了剧变。在她的朋友被直接送进牢房之前，她自己决定找出真相。
